description: Sim 93 — RIFT Bayesian Model Comparison. Computes the log-Bayes factor ln B(RIFT/LCDM) via the Savage-Dickey density ratio. LCDM is RIFT at Lambda0=0 (nested model), so B = p(Lambda0=0|data) / p(Lambda0=0|prior). MCMC over (H0, Omega_m, rd, Lambda0) using the SIM90 joint CMB+BAO likelihood. Results for three prior choices (uniform, log-uniform, half-Gaussian).

mcmc.note: emcee ensemble sampler. 64 walkers x 5000 steps = 320000 total, 256000 post-burnin.

log_uniform.note: Scale-invariant Jeffreys-like prior on positive quantity

half_gaussian.note: Weakly informative — centered at GR, scale from BAO best-fit

bao.data: BOSS DR12 + eBOSS DR16 + Lya (same as SIM87/SIM90)
bao.note: 12x12 covariance matrix from Alam+2017, Alam+2021, Bourboux+2020

evidence.note: B(RIFT/LCDM) = p(Lambda0=0|data) / p(Lambda0=0|prior). Valid because LCDM is RIFT with Lambda0=0 (nested models). Posterior density at Lambda0=0 estimated via KDE on MCMC chain.

base_cosmology.note: SIM90 joint best-fit used as MCMC initialisation center
